story_clips.heygen_prompt: Photorealistic documentary-style vertical shot, shot on a 35 mm lens, late afternoon on open grazing hills in rural Telangana: red soil, scattered rocks, dry grass and a lone neem tree. An elderly Indian shepherd in a faded white dhoti, plain cotton shirt and a simple cloth turban, natural skin texture with pores and fine wrinkles, grey stubble, walks slowly behind a flock of brown and white Deccani sheep, a long wooden staff in his hand, guiding them home along a dirt path toward a distant village with tiled roofs. Medium-wide shot from behind and to the side, his face not in close-up, nobody talking to camera. Soft golden sunset light with dust in the air, slight handheld camera slowly tracking alongside, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no plastic-looking skin, no extra fingers, no extra legs, no distorted animals.

Photorealistic documentary-style vertical shot, shot on a 35 mm lens, a weekend morning in a rural Telangana village courtyard with a tiled roof, whitewashed mud wall and a neem tree: an Indian grandmother in a faded cotton saree, natural skin texture with fine wrinkles, stirs a thick red mutton curry with bone-in pieces in a blackened clay pot over a wood fire, then ladles a portion onto a fresh banana leaf placed on a woven mat beside a steel tumbler of water. The curry and banana leaf are in sharp focus in the foreground; her face is only partly visible and not in close-up; nobody eats or talks to camera. Warm natural daylight with wood-fire glow and rising steam, slight handheld camera slowly pushing in, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no plastic-looking skin, no extra fingers.
